notes:
Summary: FluxForge builds low-latency personalization for live multiplayer games (chat + event-driven content). Extremely latency- and cost-sensitive — want production LLM runtimes that hit p95 latency SLAs while keeping per-token costs low. Interested in Dedicated and Private, strong interest in Redwood Optimize (batching/caching/quantization) + Redwood-run perf benchmarking.

Key requirements / asks:
- Target latency: p50 < 10ms, p95 <= 40ms for 128-512 token chat context (session cache hot paths).
- Throughput target: sustained 100-200 qps per region (NA prim.), spike to 800 qps for tournament windows.
- Cost sensitivity: target < $0.0006 / token equivalent for chat flows; strong ROI pressure from product team.
- Model preferences: prefer Llama2-13B or equivalent open weights; willing to evaluate 8-bit/4-bit quantized variants if quality delta < 3% on generation metrics.
- Routing/fallback: must support regional routing + automatic fallback to smaller model when Dedicated capacity exhausted.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logs, KMS integration, retention policy controls, and option for on-prem air-gapped evaluation if needed for tournaments.

Quotes from calls:
- "We cannot exceed ~40ms p95 or players complain — player retention drops fast." — CTO Aaron Locke (02/10).
- "If you can show quantized 8-bit with negligible quality loss and a clear cost win, that's huge for us." — Lead ML Eng (Sana Mir).
